name: Mars
description: Mars is an interactive environment benchmark designed to evaluate situated inductive reasoning by requiring agents to interact with a dynamic environment, derive rules, and perform decision-making tasks under counter-commonsense game mechanisms.
reputation: A very recent research benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly used in the originating paper to study interactive situated reasoning.
notes: Focuses on situated inductive reasoning in an open-world environment with interactive tasks and counter-commonsense challenges.
